# MoltZip

> A free archive extractor for Windows, macOS and Linux that extracts in place: it cuts the archive away as the files come out, so it needs free space for the extracted files only, not for the files and the archive together.

Site: https://morningstar-code.github.io/moltzip (Spanish: /es/). Downloads and issues: https://github.com/morningstar-code/moltzip. Free to use; the source code is private. Current version 0.3.0. A desktop app (English and Spanish) and a command line tool, `moltzip` (short name `mz`).

## What it does

- Extracts ZIP (ZIP64, self-extracting .exe), 7z (solid and non-solid), RAR 5 and RAR 4 (single files and volume sets), tar, .tar.gz/.tgz, .tar.xz/.txz, .tar.zst/.tzst, .tar.bz2/.tbz2, and split .001 archives
- Extracts from the end of the archive and truncates it behind each committed batch, so a 180 GB archive that unpacks to 200 GB needs a little over 200 GB instead of 380 GB
- Checks that the extraction fits before it changes anything; keeps 2 GB free by default (`--keep-free`)
- Reads every extracted file back from the disk and compares its checksum before the archive bytes holding it are cut (`--no-verify-written` turns this off)
- `check`, `list` and `test` take `--json` for scripts
- Crash safe: stop it, kill it or lose power at any moment and the same command resumes; `moltzip restore` turns what is left into a normal archive
- Never overwrites existing files unless asked; refuses hostile archives before anything is deleted
- No network access, no telemetry

## Install

- Windows: https://github.com/morningstar-code/moltzip/releases/latest/download/MoltZip-x64-setup.exe
- macOS: MoltZip-aarch64.dmg (Apple Silicon), MoltZip-x86_64.dmg (Intel) from the latest release
- Linux: MoltZip-x86_64.AppImage, moltzip_amd64.deb, moltzip-x86_64.rpm from the latest release
- Command line: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/morningstar-code/moltzip/main/install.sh | sh` or, on Windows, `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/morningstar-code/moltzip/main/install.ps1 | iex`

## Usage

- `moltzip check game.zip`: will it fit, changes nothing
- `moltzip extract game.zip`: extract in place into ./game/
- `moltzip extract game.zip --keep-archive`: normal extraction, archive kept
- `moltzip restore game.zip`: give up on an unfinished extraction
